entry.description: Number of the equation in `equations` (1 = first) the reaction is printed in

results.description: Numbers of this reaction's results in the equation's `results` (1 = first); empty when the equation prints none

variant.description: Key of the equation's variant this reaction runs; null when it has none

footnote_markers.description: Markers of the equation that apply to this reaction

distinguishing.description: Only when the equation reports more than one reaction: what sets this one apart, as printed; else null

participant_keys.description: The participants of the equation whose drawing carries the symbol

variables.description: Values of variable groups printed for this reaction ('X = Cl'); empty as a rule

reactions.description: Every reaction of the block in equation order: one per equation, unless an equation reports several experiments

notes.description: Why an equation was split, or what is unusual about it; nothing for plain equations

issues.description: Doubts a reviewer should look at
